plain: Able to be seen or told apart by the mind.

webster.text: That may be seen distinctly; discoverable by the eye or the understanding; distinguishable.

example.quote: From these premises it is clearly discernible that it would be wrong to change the nature of the contracts.
example.cite: Jonathan Elliot, ed., The Debates in the Several State Conventions on the Adoption of the Federal Constitution, vol. 3, Virginia Convention, June 21, 1788 (2d ed. 1836)
